_how_to: Station 419 on the front page. 'tv' plays ONE video: a YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook video link, or a pasted <iframe> video embed code. 'radio' plays ONE audio show: a Spotify, Apple Podcasts, SoundCloud, Buzzsprout, Podbean or Anchor episode link, a pasted <iframe> embed code from any podcast host, an .mp3 file, or a podcast RSS feed (always plays the newest episode). Leave a 'url' empty for the 'coming soon' screen. Optional: 'link' (where the 'at the source' button goes) and, for the radio, 'image' (cover art for .mp3 or RSS).
